repo_notes: This repository contains a high-performance off-chain Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) tailored for options trading.
The core focus is on the Options Trading Engine, the zkVM proving infrastructure, and the Based Rollup sequencing.
The execution engine matches options trades off-chain at microsecond latency.
The zkVM integration and lattice-based cryptography generate succinct proofs of matching correctness and risk state transitions.

pages.title: Options Trading Engine (Core CLOB)
pages.purpose: The core off-chain matching engine, in-memory orderbook structures (B-Trees/Queues), and trade execution logic.

pages.title: zkVM Proving Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Integration with zkVMs (SP1/RISC Zero), guest programs for proving trade validity, and the Lighter Prover implementation.

pages.title: Based Rollup Sequencer
pages.purpose: The L2 sequencing layer that collects orders into deterministic batches, computes state roots, and manages Data Availability (EIP-4844 blobs).

pages.title: Risk & Margin Engine
pages.purpose: Off-chain risk management including margin calculation, wash trade detection, Auto-Deleveraging (ADL), and volatility fusion.

pages.title: Circuit-Compatible Options Math
pages.purpose: Fixed-point mathematical implementations designed to run deterministically inside the zkVM for Black-Scholes pricing and Greeks.

pages.title: Lattice Cryptography
pages.purpose: Quantum-resistant LatticeFold+ implementations, SIS commitments, and recursive folding for proof aggregation.
